name: gyc/vision
title: Vision
description: Heading and two paragraphs next to a three-photo mosaic

lead.default: GYC Europe is a movement of young Adventists passionate about sharing the transformative power of the gospel across the continent. We believe in empowering a generation to be fearless witnesses for Christ — informed in faith, connected in community, and bold in mission.

text.default: Our vision is to see European youth rise up — equipped, inspired, and sent — to proclaim the three angels' messages with clarity and compassion, while embracing a culture of excellence and service.
